articles.title: Static electricity remains shockingly mysterious
articles.snippet: Despite studying static charge for centuries, scientists still aren’t clear on precisely how it works.
articles.summary: Even though scientists have studied static charge for hundreds of years, they still do not know exactly how it works. Researchers are still trying to figure out this shockingly mysterious process.

articles.title: Analyze This: Microbes can make valuable chemicals more sustainably
articles.snippet: Food waste-fed bacteria may someday make chemical ingredients for medicines, cosmetics and more.
articles.summary: Bacteria fed with food waste might one day be used to create chemical ingredients for medicines and cosmetics. This process could help produce valuable chemicals more sustainably.

articles.summary: Wave-particle duality is one of the strangest parts of quantum physics. This concept is about how particles act like waves.

articles.title: Would growing a big heart make the Grinch strong?
articles.snippet: In the classic Dr. Seuss tale, the Grinch’s heart grows in an instant. That probably wouldn’t have been good for him — unless he was a snake.
articles.summary: In the story, the Grinch's heart grows instantly, which would not be good for a human. However, this sudden change might have been fine if he were a snake.
